payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterate possible max values j=1..30; for each, run Kadane's max subarray sum on elements ≤j, then compute max_sum - j. Answer is max of these.
payload.rationale: Uses a linear 1D DP (Kadane) to find max subarray sum under a threshold, repeated for each candidate max value; no 2D state or complex data structures.
